name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.104.0 — review-legs.js writes the evidence manifest to <manifest>.partial and renames it only after the summary, so a runner killed mid-wave leaves no manifest-N.jsonl the driver can advance over (AC-20260820-07-14). 7.103.0 — `/spec:mocks` gains a `KIT` state between `SHAPES` and `WIREFRAMES`: `design/kit/<name>.html` is a canon family sibling to `design/shell/`, under the same marks, the same checker, and the same walk-up resolution (`resolveCanonDir`, generalised off `resolveShellDir`), naming every shared primitive once per family with a when-to-use line, gray, signed off via `stop open kit` / `--mark kit-signed` on a page that shows the kit itself. Once a kit family resolves, every content region of a labeled mock carries `data-kit="<key>"` or `data-bespoke="<key>: <difference>"`; `check` prints the running `ⓘ <label>: <n> kit, <m> bespoke` count (after the CHECK block, never before it) and `journey-approved` refuses on an unmarked region. `--reopen kit` clears the sign-off and the terminal approval only. A host with no `design/kit/` is byte-identical to before. 7.102.0 — the review fix-cap survives a cold restart — spec-review-driver counts this spec's uncleared `escalated:true` ledger rows as spent iterations, so deleting the sidecar no longer resets the loop (dispositions warns before workers are dispatched into a spent cap); design Step 6 gains the blocking AC ↔ design-landed reconcile (`design-ac-reconcile.js`: an AC naming a landed component must be tagged `[pre-green: design-landed]` or cited in Decisions before `designed:` stamps); exit 124 from the gate or a red-check run auto-records a `test-watchdog-trip` incident on the build row.
